# Numi AI

> Numi AI is an AI automation consultancy for small and medium businesses (pymes) in Colombia. It builds AI agents that answer customers instantly on WhatsApp 24/7, automations that book appointments and follow up on leads, and professional websites — so business owners stop losing sales to slow replies.

Numi AI is based in Medellín, Colombia, and serves businesses across Colombia.

## What Numi AI does

Five service areas, combined into each client's system rather than sold as separate line items:

- **Process assessment** — maps how the business works today (who does what, in what order, where time/information/customers get lost) and delivers a concrete plan of what to reorder, automate, or leave untouched.
- **Smart chatbots** — trained on the business's own data to answer prices, hours and FAQs in seconds, day or night.
- **Process automation** — appointment booking/confirmation, follow-up with leads who went quiet, and logging every contact in one panel, running unattended in the background.
- **Cognitive AI agents** — go beyond text replies: check live calendar availability, confirm bookings, update customer records, and hand off to a human teammate with full context when needed.
- **Professional websites** — home, services, portfolio and a contact form wired directly to WhatsApp; fast-loading and optimized for Colombian search.

## How to engage

The entry point is a **free strategy call**. The visitor leaves with a clear diagnosis of what is worth automating, whether or not they hire Numi AI.

## Pricing

Two fixed-price plans plus a custom tier. All prices are in Colombian pesos (COP) and are "from" prices — WhatsApp's own per-message fees through Meta are billed separately and estimated from the client's volume.

1. **Agente Esencial** — from COP $999,990 one-time setup, maintenance from COP $300,000/month. For businesses that don't automate anything today: a WhatsApp agent that answers prices, hours and FAQs instantly, books real appointments against Google Calendar without double-booking, follows up automatically if the customer doesn't confirm, and notifies the business of new leads.
2. **Agente Avanzado** (most chosen) — from COP $1,900,000 one-time setup, maintenance from COP $550,000/month. Everything in Agente Esencial, plus: escalates conversations to a team member with full context when needed, a dashboard to see and manage every conversation and contact, multi-step automatic follow-up for unresponsive leads, a weekly report, and one additional channel (Instagram or Messenger).
3. **A la medida (Custom)** — priced after the assessment call. For businesses with multiple locations or a more complex operation: full process automation (not just customer service), integration with the business's own systems, a full website and digital presence, and a monthly strategy session.

Both fixed plans include the assessment, the build, loading the business's information, the agreed integrations, testing until it works, hosting, monitoring and support.

## Documented result

A real client, Casas y Espacios Inmobiliaria (Medellín), reports +40% more customer-service capacity without hiring new staff: "Antes perdíamos consultas de apartamentos porque no alcanzábamos a responder a tiempo. Con el asistente, cada mensaje se atiende al instante y solo llegan a nosotros los interesados listos para agendar."

This is the only measured outcome Numi AI publishes; it is a single documented client result, not a representative average.

## Tools and channels it integrates with

WhatsApp Business API, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Google Calendar, Outlook, Google Sheets, HubSpot, web forms, and any tool with an open API.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

- All page content is server-rendered; no JavaScript execution is required to read the text.
- Structured data (JSON-LD `ProfessionalService` with a `makesOffer` list of the pricing plans, `WebSite`, and `FAQPage`) is embedded in the `<head>` of the home page. Prefer parsing that over scraping the rendered page.
- The FAQ accordion on the home page answers the most common buyer questions (implementation time, what happens if the agent can't answer, exact pricing, technical skill required, tool compatibility, cancellation) and is also exposed as `FAQPage` structured data.
- Requesting any locale home page with `Accept: text/markdown` returns this summary as plain markdown instead of rendered HTML.
- Do not use the contact email or WhatsApp number for anything other than legitimate business inquiries about Numi AI's services.
